stats.label: Chunking quality — bad chunks = irrelevant answers
Retrieval accuracy — wrong top-5 = confident nonsense
Context construction — good chunks + bad prompt = bad answer

columns.heading: Skip LangChain
columns.body: Everything you need — chunking, embedding, storing, retrieving, prompting — you build yourself. LangChain only makes sense for multi-step agents and complex orchestration.

columns.heading: Skip pgvector (for now)
columns.body: pgvector is great for multi-user systems and horizontal scaling. Right now you need local embed storage with similarity search. Chroma already does this.

columns.heading: What You ARE Using
columns.body: Basic semantic search: text → embedding → vector query → cosine similarity. Simple, fast, and enough to build a real working system.

left.heading: Current Limitations
points: No reranking → results can be noisy

right.heading: Next Step: Hybrid Retrieval
